day_shape: 68 items dominated by Ali Khamenei's Tehran funeral with regime channels running blanket coverage, Mojtaba Khamenei reappointing judiciary chief Mohseni-Ejei, Israel-Lebanon framework signed and IDF strikes near Nabatieh, nothing from UK Parliament, OFAC or IAEA.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral procession in Tehran
threads.summary: Regime broadcasters IRIB and Defa Press ran continuous live coverage of Ali Khamenei's funeral at Freedom Square, with Iran International and Jerusalem Post reporting hundreds of thousands attending and red revenge flags waved on day three. IRIB said President Pezeshkian, the Central Bank governor and Economy Minister Madani-zadeh attended, and cited messages from Iraq's Muqtada al-Sadr and Bangladesh's foreign minister.

threads.label: Mojtaba Khamenei's succession and judiciary reappointment
threads.summary: Khamenei's office announced by decree that new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei reappointed Gholam-Hossein Mohseni-Ejei as judiciary head, despite earlier reports of disagreement, per Jerusalem Post. Iran International reported succession-related elite contests continue after Ali Khamenei's death, while Iran's government spokeswoman Fatemeh Mohajerani said Tehran will pursue a legal complaint against Israel and the US over the assassination.

threads.label: Foreign delegations at funeral and Yemen complaint
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Israel's security establishment monitoring the arrival in Tehran of leaders and senior officials from designated terrorist organisations for Khamenei's funeral. Yemen's internationally recognised government condemned Iran for operating a flight transporting Houthi figures to attend the ceremonies.

threads.label: Israel-Lebanon framework and southern Lebanon strikes
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Ambassador Yechiel Leiter opened the fifth round of Israel-Lebanon talks in Washington which ended with both sides signing a framework, with Lebanese President Aoun defending the agreement publicly. The IDF struck a Hezbollah motorcycle cell in al-Aaqaide near Nabatieh and reported a further strike between Kfar Tebnit and Nabatieh al-Fawqa; Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir toured the Beaufort Ridge tunnel system and called Hezbollah "exhausted".

threads.label: Gaza governance, hostages and October 7 anniversary
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Hamas is expected to dissolve its Gaza "committee for monitoring government activity" per two Hamas sources, and that the Palestinian Authority rejected the Trump Board of Peace's exclusion of UNRWA from postwar Gaza. Israel is building a special tribunal for Hamas suspects with first trials expected no earlier than 2028, as the IDF marks 1,000 days since October 7.

threads.label: Iran war fallout and regional pressure points
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post cited a Financial Times poll indicating most US voters view the war with Iran as not worth the cost, while CENTCOM said it suspended search efforts for a sailor missing since Wednesday after an MH-60S Seahawk went down in the Arabian Sea. Separate analysis flagged Iranian-backed Houthi frontline reinforcement in Yemen over the past month and Iranian-backed attacks from Iraq targeting Gulf states.

events.title_en: Video: Tehran; today the capital of the free of the world. Qavomi, correspondent of IRIB: Today Tehran is not only the capital of Iran, but the capital...
events.summary_en: Video: Tehran; today the capital of the free of the world. Qavomi, correspondent of IRIB: Today Tehran is not only the capital of Iran, but the capital of the Islamic world and the free people of the earth; people who have gathered to bid farewell to their martyred leader. The martyred leader who stood against tyranny and despotism, resisted for his people and chose martyrdom, is being laid to rest with full grandeur today. We, the people, will continue the illuminated path of truth and righteousness and will forever carry the lofty spirit of this martyr with us. We will make resistance, truth and righteousness our calling and will continue this luminous path forever.

Thus it is demonstrated once again that the impact of the martyr exceeds that of the living individual. An excerpt from the message of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution | 20 Farvardin 1405. events.summary:
Report: Iran will pursue a legal complaint against Israel and the US for the assassination of former supreme leader Ali Khamenei, the Iranian government spokeswoman, Fatemeh Mohajerani, said.
